reason: Version 4 keeps the facts, metrics, commitments, and caveats almost verbatim. Version 2 only adds that the system handles routine reassignments; version 1 keeps every section but shifts nuances (actual harm vs. at risk, pass-off vs. escalation, where someone lives, and testing whether the target is realistic); version 3 drops secondary goals and non-goals, softens the metric set, and changes the median-time and escalation definitions.
